# split-autobalance (Rex's Autobalance splits; this config turns it on):
# after a split, a close or a move the panes even out — three side by side
# get a third each, not 50/25/25.
expect-layout:a
key:cmd+d
wait:0.8
key:cmd+d
wait:0.8
expect-layout:h33(a,h50(b,c))
# c closes: two halves.
key:cmd+w
wait:1.0
expect-layout:h50(a,b)
# b moved below a: even again.
key:cmd+d
wait:0.8
expect-layout:h33(a,h50(b,d))
drop:1:down
expect-layout:h50(v50(a,d),b)
